scope: Recovery when a local reply model proposes web queries that the private-corpus gate refuses.
method: Read-only review of the final implementation and regression-test diff; no edits or tests by the reviewer.
result: No blocking findings. Refused queries stay local. Specific bounded pair feedback allows fresh wording within the two-tool budget. After all searches are refused, an unsupported current answer is replaced with a truthful fallback, including when guidance supplied the location. Standalone butler help, deliberate silence, and later non-search tool answers remain available.
remainingLimit: The standalone-help exception is narrow; another non-current request can receive a generic search-failure reply after an unnecessary refused search. Focused tests are synthetic and do not exercise a configured local model or search credential.
